 Duke is back in action Saturday against the NC State Wolfpack. Here are the players to watch for an important rivalry game Jared Feinberg | Share on Facebook Share on X Add us as a preferred source Oct 31, 2026; Durham, North Carolina, USA; Duke Blue Devils head coach Manny Diaz before kick off against the Boston College Eagles at Wallace Wade Stadium.  Duke Blue Devils The Duke Blue Devils are back in action, looking to ride their new wave of momentum with a potential win over rival NC State.
--> The Duke Blue Devils are back in action, looking to ride their new wave of momentum with a potential win over rival NC State.
 The Blue Devils have gotten some great play from role players in recent weeks as injuries have piled up, but some key players return on Saturday for a critical game before a trip to South Beach next week. Here are five players that Blue Devils fans should watch on Saturday against the Wolfpack. 
--> The Blue Devils have gotten some great play from role players in recent weeks as injuries have piled up, but some key players return on Saturday for a critical game before a trip to South Beach next week. Here are five players that Blue Devils fans should watch on Saturday against the Wolfpack. 
 Andrew Pellicciotta, Safety
--> Andrew Pellicciotta, Safety
 Sep 19, 2026; Durham, North Carolina, USA; Duke Blue Devils safety Andrew Pellicciotta (35) celebrates against the Stanford Cardinal during the first half at Wallace Wade Stadium. Mandatory Credit: James Guillory-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect The Blue Devils get their top safety back this week after missing the last two games with an injury he suffered against the North Carolina Tar Heels. 
--> The Blue Devils get their top safety back this week after missing the last two games with an injury he suffered against the North Carolina Tar Heels. 
 Pellicciotta's range, tackling ability, and knack for the football are a sight to see, and Duke has done a swell job using Patrick Smith-Young in Pellicciotta's role. With their top punt returner back, look for Duke to have a strong defensive back end and return game on special teams.

 Javen Nicholas, Wide Receiver
--> Javen Nicholas, Wide Receiver
 Oct 31, 2026; Durham, North Carolina, USA; The Duke Blue Devil during the second quarter against the Boston College Eagles at Wallace Wade Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Zachary Taft-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect We're slowly starting to see Nicholas get some touches, and anytime he has touched the ball, good things have occurred for Duke's offense. 
--> We're slowly starting to see Nicholas get some touches, and anytime he has touched the ball, good things have occurred for Duke's offense. 
 Nicholas had a big play early against Boston College that could suggest he is starting to find his role under offensive coordinator Jonathan Brewer. If that is the case, look for Nicholas to get more playing time this week as Duke looks to get its best talents on the field in the final stretch.

 Dylan Flowers, Cornerback
--> Dylan Flowers, Cornerback
 Oct 17, 2026; Durham, North Carolina, USA; North Carolina Tar Heels wide receiver Jordan Shipp (1) runs the ball against Duke Blue Devils cornerback Dylan Flowers (0) during the first quarter at Wallace Wade Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Zachary Taft-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Arguably the best cornerback on the team thus far, with an argument for Kyon Loud, Flowers is wearing the No. 0 jersey well. His play in coverage and run support have been splendid, and he looks like a big steal for head coach Manny Diaz from the transfer portal. 
--> Arguably the best cornerback on the team thus far, with an argument for Kyon Loud, Flowers is wearing the No. 0 jersey well. His play in coverage and run support have been splendid, and he looks like a big steal for head coach Manny Diaz from the transfer portal. 
 Flowers will have a tough outing next week in Miami, but this week, he has a chance to shut down an entire portion of the field against the Wolfpack's perimeter weapons.

 Nate Sheppard, Running Back
--> Nate Sheppard, Running Back
 Oct 31, 2026; Durham, North Carolina, USA; Duke Blue Devils running back Nate Sheppard (20) looks on after scoring his fifth rushing touchdown of the game during the third quarter against the Boston College Eagles at Wallace Wade Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Zachary Taft-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect After a historic five-touchdown performance against Boston College, the Blue Devils' star running back is starting his Heisman campaign with a bang. 
--> After a historic five-touchdown performance against Boston College, the Blue Devils' star running back is starting his Heisman campaign with a bang.
